description: Global Reservoir and Dam Database is a data resource listed in Free GIS Data (rtwilson), a curated list of free geographic datasets under the section "Lakes, Oceans and other Water Sources", published or maintained by the publisher of atlas.gwsp.org. Geographically-referenced data on all reservoirs with a storage capacity of more than 0.1 cubic kilometres. The data consists of polygons outlining reservoirs at high spatial resolution with extensive metadata about the dam and reservoir. Registration required. Coverage: worldwide or as described in the list entry. The list files it under "Lakes, Oceans and other Water Sources" with the note that registration is required. The entry links to atlas.gwsp.org. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge but needs registration according to the listing; the conditions were not read. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure mapping and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-free-gis-data-list.
